status_vocabulary.semantic_only: Canonical API and IR semantics exist, but the public executable path does not run this feature yet.
status_vocabulary.reference_executable: Executable on the trusted reference lane used for correctness and validation.
status_vocabulary.production_executable: Executable on the intended production lane.
status_vocabulary.validated: Executable and benchmarked with explicit regression coverage for the documented workload.

features.label: SlonczewskiSTT
features.notes: Current public executable subset supports a single Slonczewski module at a time, with either inline current_density or a named CurrentTransport prescribed_density source. Native FEM CPU/GPU execute this subset; the Rust FEM reference runner still does not.

features.label: ZhangLiSTT
features.notes: Current public executable subset supports a single Zhang-Li module at a time, with either inline current_density or a named CurrentTransport prescribed_density source. Native FEM CPU/GPU execute the P1 element-gradient approximation; the Rust FEM reference runner still does not.

features.label: InterfaceCppSTT
features.notes: Canonical placeholder for interface-local CPP multilayer torque.

features.label: DriftDiffusionSpinTorque
features.notes: Deferred until current transport and spin accumulation are modeled explicitly.

features.label: SpinOrbitTorque
features.notes: Canonical placeholder for damping-like and field-like SOT.

features.label: OerstedCylinder constant envelope
features.notes: Analytic infinite-cylinder Oersted support exists on FDM plus the public MFEM/libCEED/hypre CPU and MFEM/libCEED/CUDA GPU FEM lanes.

features.label: OerstedCylinder sinusoidal envelope
features.notes: Same executable status as the constant envelope on FDM and native FEM.

features.label: OerstedCylinder pulse envelope
features.notes: Public FDM and MFEM FEM planners lower pulse envelopes.

features.label: OerstedCylinder piecewise_linear envelope
features.notes: Current FDM planner rejects piecewise-linear Oersted envelopes explicitly.

features.label: OerstedField from_current_solution (cylindrical prescribed density)
features.notes: Executable when the named CurrentTransport uses prescribed_density in a cylindrical solve_region with axis-aligned current; planner lowers to the exact infinite-cylinder Oersted realization on FDM plus the public MFEM/libCEED/hypre CPU and MFEM/libCEED/CUDA GPU FEM lanes.

features.label: OerstedField from_current_solution (general prescribed density, midpoint Biot-Savart)
features.notes: For non-cylindrical prescribed-density solve regions, the public planner lowers to a midpoint Biot-Savart field with equivalent-sphere self regularization. CPU-reference FDM executes the single-body per-cell slice with an explicit active-source-cell cap; native CUDA FDM executes the same planner-resolved per-cell field; the public MFEM/libCEED/hypre CPU and MFEM/libCEED/CUDA GPU FEM lanes execute the per-node slice.

features.label: STNO vortex reference benchmark
features.notes: Canonical minimal benchmark is `examples/stno_vortex_ref_minimal.py`; artifact-analysis regressions exist, but the full solver benchmark is not yet CI-validated end-to-end.

features.label: Artifact-backed STNO report
features.notes: Uses `scalars.csv` and optional `fields/m` snapshots.

features.label: CurrentTransport prescribed_density
features.notes: Writes `current_transport/<name>.json` auxiliary artifacts on the public FDM path and on the public MFEM/libCEED/hypre CPU and MFEM/libCEED/CUDA GPU FEM lanes. Prescribed transport no longer forces FEM GPU fallback; only antenna_field_source still does.

features.label: CurrentTransport ohmic_poisson
features.notes: Deferred.

features.label: FEM periodic or Floquet spin-wave support
features.notes: k=0 static-periodic driven response is partial-production-executable on native FEM CPU/GPU magnetic slices, and no-demag nonzero-k Floquet driven response is executable as a narrow phase-projected tangent slice. This does not promote Floquet dynamic demag-k, full periodic exchange-graph assembly, periodic Poisson, or modal k-path production.

features.label: FEM eigenmodes with imported equilibrium from time-domain artifacts
features.notes: Keep status explicit; do not imply end-to-end STNO parity.

features.label: FEM modal interior-window eigensolve
features.notes: Modal eigen product only. Eigenmodes uses tangent variables with explicit interval targets such as frequency_min_hz and frequency_max_hz. Production promotion requires the audit P0 gyrotropic contract: lambda = i omega or an explicitly transformed equivalent pencil with tested eigenvalue-to-frequency mapping. This status does not promote driven response.

features.label: FEM driven frequency response
features.notes: Driven response product only. Frequency Response solves an explicitly defined harmonic system such as (i omega B_alpha - L) q = b at requested frequencies. Audit P0 blocks new production promotion until phasor convention, matrix form, dynamic-demag sign, Ms-correct susceptibility/absorbed-power units, damping convention, and tangent-frame transport are implemented and tested. The native FEM CPU lane is partial-production-executable for the gamma/free-boundary, k=0 static-periodic magnetic, no-demag nonzero-k Floquet phase-projection, and diagnostic periodic_airbox_k0 Schur/provider slices with dynamic demag via backend tangent provider. The native FEM GPU lane is partial-production-executable for gamma/free-boundary, k=0 static-periodic magnetic/compacted shared-domain, no-demag nonzero-k Floquet phase-projection, and narrow periodic_airbox_k0 Schur/provider slices with ordinary k=0 demag through the backend provider; open/gamma and k=0 static-periodic GPU DMI use the persistent CUDA magnetic-operator context with a weak-residual tangent kernel when complete P1 element DMI payloads are supplied. periodic_airbox_k0 on GPU requires the demag tangent-with-potential provider to be created on the GPU demag backend for the Schur route, accepts lane-appropriate matrix-free coupled-block providers, does not accept explicit CPU dense/coupled-block payloads as GPU proof, and does not promote modal eigensolve, nonzero-k Floquet DMI assembly, nonzero-k demag-k Poisson assembly, or fully device-resident Krylov. periodic_airbox_k0.production_cpu_not_validated and periodic_airbox_k0.production_gpu_not_validated are temporary UI diagnostic reasons for missing lane-specific managed production proof, not capability states.

features.label: StudyIR::FrequencyResponse / fm.FrequencyResponse
features.notes: First-class public semantics exist in Python API and ProblemIR. The native FEM CPU lane is partial-production-executable for the gamma/free-boundary, k=0 static-periodic magnetic, no-demag nonzero-k Floquet phase-projection, and diagnostic periodic_airbox_k0 Schur/provider response slices, and the dense FEM response lane remains reference-executable for validation artifacts. Static-periodic response requires mesh.periodic_node_pairs metadata. The native FEM GPU lane is partial-production-executable for gamma/free-boundary, k=0 static-periodic magnetic/compacted shared-domain, no-demag nonzero-k Floquet phase-projection, and narrow periodic_airbox_k0 Schur/provider slices with ordinary k=0 dynamic demag through a backend provider while local/exchange application remains CUDA-backed through a persistent CUDA magnetic-operator context; open/gamma and k=0 static-periodic GPU DMI use the same context with a CUDA weak-residual tangent kernel when complete P1 element DMI payloads are supplied. GPU periodic_airbox_k0 requires the demag tangent-with-potential provider to be created on the GPU demag backend for the Schur route, accepts lane-appropriate matrix-free coupled-block providers, and must not accept explicit CPU dense/coupled-block payloads as GPU proof. This does not implement native nonzero-k demag-k Poisson assembly, nonzero-k Floquet DMI assembly, modal eigensolve, missing periodic pair metadata, magnetoelastic response, dense coupled-block GPU response, or fully device-resident Krylov. Runtime capabilities expose broad supports_frequency_response, supports_coupled_magnetoelastic_quasistatic, supports_coupled_magnetoelastic_elastodynamic, supports_frequency_domain_elastodynamics, and supports_coupled_eigenmodes as false; frequency_domain_capabilities.v1 is the precise UI-gating source. periodic_airbox_k0.production_cpu_not_validated and periodic_airbox_k0.production_gpu_not_validated are temporary diagnostic rejection/degraded-state reasons, not public execution modes.
